papers.title: ESIM: an Open Event Camera Simulator
papers.potential_relevance: 事件相机拟采购；ESIM 是事件相机仿真的事实标准之一，可从渲染序列生成事件流，用于构造事件相机退化/失效场景（暗光、高动态、丢包式事件缺失需自行叠加）
papers.verification_evidence: DBLP API (curl https://dblp.org/search/publ/api?q=event+camera+simulator&format=json) 返回条目 'ESIM: an Open Event Camera Simulator | CoRL | 2018 | no-doi | http://proceedings.mlr.press/v87/rebecq18a.html'；作者字段来自同一 JSON（Rebecq 等）
papers.notes: 官方仓库 uzh-rpg/rpg_esim 已单独经 GitHub API 核验（MIT）。注意名字冲突：同名 ESIM 也是 2000 年电路故障模拟器（已记入 rejected）。可信边界：事件生成质量依赖渲染分辨率与光强模型，时间分辨率可超实时，但传感器噪声为参数化模型，不代表真实 DVS 噪声特性。

papers.title: The event-camera dataset and simulator: Event-based data for pose estimation, visual odometry, and SLAM
papers.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR)
papers.potential_relevance: 同时提供事件相机数据集与配套仿真器（ESIM 前身），可作为事件相机仿真结果的真值参照与对比基准
papers.verification_evidence: DBLP API 返回条目 'The event-camera dataset and simulator... | Int. J. Robotics Res. | 2017 | 10.1177/0278364917691115'；arXiv id 1610.08336 亦由 DBLP ee 字段给出
papers.notes: 仿真部分与数据集部分同文，便于做 sim-to-real 一致性检查。

papers.title: v2e: From Video Frames to Realistic DVS Events
papers.venue: 2021 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW)
papers.potential_relevance: 从普通视频帧生成带阈值/延迟/噪声模型的事件流；可把现有实车视频转成事件流，构造事件相机退化输入，避免重新采数据
papers.verification_evidence: Crossref API (curl https://api.crossref.org/works?query.title=v2e) 返回 'v2e: From Video Frames to Realistic DVS Events | Hu, Liu, Delbruck | 2021 | CVPRW | DOI:10.1109/cvprw53098.2021.00144'；官方仓库 SensorsINI/v2e 经 GitHub API 核验（MIT，pushed 2026-04-13）
papers.notes: 注意：记忆中的 PLoS ONE DOI（10.1371/journal.pone.0244664）经 Crossref 直接查询被证伪（是无关论文），本条只采信 CVPRW 版本。可信边界：模型化噪声（阈值失配、leak、refractory），不能复现真实像素电路全部行为（见 ADV2E 批评）。

papers.title: Physical-Based Event Camera Simulator
papers.potential_relevance: 物理化事件生成（考虑像素电路物理），适合研究事件仿真'可信边界'：哪些物理效应被建模、哪些被忽略
papers.verification_evidence: DBLP API (q=event camera simulator) 返回 'Physical-Based Event Camera Simulator | ECCV | 2024 | 10.1007/978-3-031-72995-9_2'；作者列表取自同一 DBLP JSON 的 authors 字段
papers.notes: 作为 v2e/ESIM 的对照方法，用于论证事件仿真的可信边界。

papers.title: Combined Physics and Event Camera Simulator for Slip Detection
papers.venue: 2025 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision Workshops (WACVW)
papers.potential_relevance: 物理引擎与事件相机仿真耦合的实例；本项目需要轮式平台动力学+传感器退化联合仿真，此文给出耦合思路
papers.verification_evidence: Crossref API 返回 DOI:10.1109/WACVW65960.2025.00104（WACV 2025）；arXiv API (id_list 含 2503.04838) 返回标题与摘要，摘要确认'物理+事件相机联合仿真'主题
papers.notes: 对象是机械臂抓取滑移检测，非车辆导航；仅取耦合仿真方法论。

papers.title: ADV2E: Bridging the Gap Between Analogue Circuit and Discrete Frames in the Video-to-Events Simulator
papers.potential_relevance: 直接论证现役 video-to-events 仿真器忽略像素模拟电路特性导致的偏差——事件仿真可信边界的直接文献证据
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API (id_list 含 2411.12250) 返回标题/作者/摘要，摘要原文：'Current simulators primarily focus on the logical behavior of event cameras. However, the fundamental analogue properties of pixel circuits are seldom considered'
papers.notes: 用于在技术报告里说明'事件仿真结果只作定性参考'的依据。

papers.title: EVIS: A Physics-Grounded Event Camera Plugin for NVIDIA Isaac Sim
papers.potential_relevance: 主流机器人仿真平台（Isaac Sim）里的事件相机插件，与 Gazebo 生态互补；可评估是否引入 Isaac 做事件+LiDAR 联合退化仿真
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API (cat:cs.RO + event camera + simulator) 返回条目与摘要：'We present EVIS: a physics-grounded event camera plugin for NVIDIA Isaac Sim that generates high-rate, fully labeled event s...'
papers.notes: 2026 年新工作，成熟度待观察。

papers.title: EsaacSim: A Multimodal Event Camera Add-on for NVIDIA Isaac Sim
papers.potential_relevance: 同上，Isaac Sim 事件相机插件第二实例，可交叉印证该路线的可用性与局限
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API 同一查询返回条目与摘要：'EsaacSim, a multimodal event camera add-on for NVIDIA Isaac Sim that enables online simulation of configurable event cameras...'
papers.notes: 与 EVIS 二选一引入即可。

papers.title: CARLA: An Open Urban Driving Simulator
papers.potential_relevance: 开源城市驾驶仿真器，内置摄像头/LiDAR/GNSS/IMU 传感器模型；城市环境与本项目轮式平台场景接近，可做 GNSS 多路径定性仿真
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API (ti:CARLA AND ti:simulator) 返回 'CARLA: An Open Urban Driving Simulator | Alexey Dosovitskiy, German Ros, Felipe Codevilla, Antonio Lopez | 2017 | arXiv:1711.03938' 及摘要（open digital assets、支持传感器仿真）
papers.notes: 名字冲突：CARLA 也是巴西 HPC 会议系列（DBLP 查询被污染，已记 conflicts）。可信边界：传感器模型为游戏引擎级近似，GNSS/LiDAR 噪声模型偏理想，仿真绝对精度不可当实车结论。

papers.title: AirSim: High-Fidelity Visual and Physical Simulation for Autonomous Vehicles
papers.venue: Field and Service Robotics (Springer Proceedings in Advanced Robotics)
papers.potential_relevance: Unreal 引擎高保真传感器仿真参照（IMU/magnetometer/GPS 模型与 API），与 CARLA 互为对照，评估'哪个仿真器传感器噪声模型更可信'
papers.verification_evidence: Crossref API (query=AirSim high fidelity...) 返回 'AirSim: High-Fidelity Visual and Physical Simulation for Autonomous Vehicles | Shah, Dey, Lovett, Kapoor | 2017 | Springer Proceedings in Advanced Robotics | DOI:10.1007/978-3-319-67361-5_40'
papers.notes: 微软已停止维护 AirSim（社区共识），选型时注意；此结论未在本会话二次核验，仅提示。

papers.title: High Fidelity Physics-Based Simulation of a 512-Channel 4D-Radar Sensor for Automotive Applications
papers.potential_relevance: 毫米波雷达拟采购；该文给出 4D 雷达全物理链路仿真（天线到点云），是毫米波雷达仿真可信边界的代表文献：全保真仿真计算代价极高，实时闭环仿真只能用简化模型
papers.verification_evidence: Crossref API (query=automotive radar sensor simulation open source) 返回 'High Fidelity Physics-Based Simulation of a 512-Channel 4D-Radar Sensor for Automotive Applications | Chipengo | 2023 | IEEE Access | DOI:10.1109/access.2023.3244137'
papers.notes: 同一作者还有 2018/2020 年 77GHz MIMO 仿真论文（Crossref 同批返回，DOI:10.1155/2018/4239725、10.1109/access.2020.3021362），可选读。

papers.title: Low-Cost, Triple-Frequency, Multi-GNSS PPP and MEMS IMU Integration for Continuous Navigation in Simulated Urban Environments
papers.venue: NAVIGATION: Journal of the Institute of Navigation
papers.potential_relevance: 用仿真城市环境构造 GNSS 退化场景并评估 PPP/INS 组合的代表性方法：先建仿真场景（遮挡/多路径），再跑实测级算法——与本项目'仿真只构造退化场景'的定位一致
papers.verification_evidence: Crossref API (query.bibliographic=GNSS outage simulation MEMS IMU navigation degraded) 返回该条（Vana, Bisnath | 2023 | NAVIGATION | DOI:10.33012/navi.578）
papers.notes: 仿真边界：城市峡谷 3D 建模与信号传播近似，多路径 NLOS 误差深度依赖模型保真度。

papers.title: Realistic Rainy Weather Simulation for LiDARs in CARLA Simulator
papers.potential_relevance: LiDAR 退化场景构造（雨致衰减/噪点）在 CARLA 内实现；可迁移为'LiDAR 退化注入插件'思路
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API (ti:CARLA AND ti:simulator) 返回条目与摘要，摘要指出既有增广方法受限于固定轨迹与标注，需可编辑场景的 LiDAR 天气仿真
papers.notes: 天气→点云退化是 LiDAR 退化构造的成熟切入点；结构退化（几何退化场景如隧道/长走廊）需另行构造。

papers.title: Lidar Light Scattering Augmentation (LISA): Physics-based Simulation of Adverse Weather Conditions for 3D Object Detection
papers.potential_relevance: 物理化 LiDAR 雨/雪/雾散射仿真（SNR/SBR 下降机制），为 LiDAR 退化注入提供机理依据
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API (all:LiDAR AND all:adverse weather AND all:simulation) 返回条目与摘要，摘要明确 'sensitive to adverse weather conditions such as rain, snow and fog due to reduced signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and signal-to-background ratio (SBR)'
papers.notes: 只能生成天气类退化；几何退化（对称结构、无特征）不在其能力范围。

papers.title: RadioRange: An Open-Source Digital Twin-based Ranging Simulator for UWB, Wi-Fi, and 5G
papers.potential_relevance: UWB 测距仿真器（含硬件损伤/NLOS 模型），与本项目 UWB dropout/NLOS 场景构造直接对口；作者组与 UrbanNav（Li-Ta Hsu）同源
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API (all:UWB AND all:simulator) 返回条目与摘要，摘要：'no open platform exists for fair, reproducible comparison across protocols under realistic hardware impairments... We present RadioRange, an open-source, positioning-first digital twin that unifies UWB...'
papers.notes: 2026 年新发布，需评估是否已开源可跑。

papers.title: UUV Simulator: A Gazebo-based package for underwater intervention and multi-robot simulation
papers.potential_relevance: Gazebo 多传感器插件化仿真框架的代表作（声呐/水动力等自定义传感器插件），其'插件式传感器误差注入'架构可复用于 UWB/毫米波雷达插件开发
papers.verification_evidence: Crossref API (query.bibliographic=UUV simulator Gazebo underwater vehicle ROS) 返回 'UUV Simulator: A Gazebo-based package... | Manhaes, Scherer, Voss, Douat | 2016 | OCEANS 2016 | DOI:10.1109/oceans.2016.7761080'
papers.notes: 水下领域，仅取架构方法论。

papers.title: Scalability of Sensor Simulation in Ros-gazebo Platform with and without Using GPU
papers.potential_relevance: ROS-Gazebo 多传感器仿真的实时性与算力瓶颈量化——决定退化场景仿真能否实时跑、跑几路传感器的可信边界依据
papers.verification_evidence: Crossref API (query.bibliographic=UWB localization simulation Gazebo ROS) 返回 'Scalability of Sensor Simulation in Ros-gazebo Platform with and without Using GPU | 2020 | Spring Simulation Conference (SpringSim 2020) | DOI:10.22360/springsim.2020.ciaas.001'；Crossref 条目未含作者字段
papers.notes: 作者字段缺失，引用前需到 DOI 页补齐。

papers.title: KITTI-CARLA: a KITTI-like dataset generated by CARLA Simulator
papers.potential_relevance: 演示'仿真复刻真实数据集传感器布局'的做法（复刻 KITTI 的 HDL64+相机安装位），可借鉴来复刻本项目实车传感器布局，使仿真退化场景与实车数据同构
papers.verification_evidence: arXiv API (ti:CARLA AND ti:simulator) 返回条目与摘要：'KITTI-CARLA is a dataset built from the CARLA v0.9.10 simulator using a vehicle with sensors identical to the KITTI dataset...'
papers.notes: 归入 SIM 而非正式数据集清单（合成数据，非真实采集）。
